    xnumel = 3025

    y1 = yindex // 96
    y3 = yindex

    tmp1 = tl.load(in_ptr1 + (y0), xmask & ymask, eviction_policy='evict_last')                        # 96-element bias — keep in L2, reused by all CTAs
